title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.
hints: Think about what complement you need for each number.
Can you use a hash map?

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Maintain a set of characters in the current window.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays `nums1` and `nums2`, return the median of the two sorted arrays.
hints: Think about binary search on the smaller array.
Partition both arrays such that left half has (m+n+1)/2 elements.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing parentheses, determine if the input string is valid.
hints: Push opening brackets, pop when closing bracket found.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.
hints: Keep track of current sum and max sum.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two sorted linked lists. Merge the two lists into one sorted list.
constraints: The number of nodes in both lists is in the range [0, 50].

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers, write a function to search target in the array.
hints: Keep track of left and right pointers
Eliminate half the search space each time

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

title: LRU Cache
description: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache.

testCases.input: capacity=2, put(1,1), put(2,2), get(1), put(3,3), get(2)

title: Word Search
description: Given an m x n grid of characters and a string word, return if word exists in the grid.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is the range [0, 5000].

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals.
hints: Sort the intervals by their start time.
If current overlaps with previous, merge them.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s.

title: Number of Islands
description: Given an m x n 2D binary grid, return the number of islands.
hints: Use DFS or BFS to explore connected land
Increment island count for each unvisited land

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
hints: dp[i] = length of LIS ending at index i
For each i, check all j < i where nums[j] < nums[i]
timeComplexity: O(n²) simple, O(n log n) optimized

title: Course Schedule
description: Determine if you can finish all courses given the prerequisites.
hints: If cycle exists, impossible to complete all

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given two strings, find the minimum window substring that contains all characters of the second string.
hints: Use sliding window with two pointers
Use hash map to track frequencies
Expand right, contract left when valid

title: Container With Most Water
description: Find two lines that together form a container such that the container holds the most water.
hints: Start with two pointers at both ends
Move the pointer with smaller height

title: Decode Ways
description: Determine the number of ways to decode an encoded message.
hints: Check if current digit is valid (1-9)
Check if last two digits form valid code

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
description: Serialize and deserialize a binary tree.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4].

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Determine if a binary tree is a valid binary search tree.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10^4].
hints: Use DFS to validate each node
Keep track of valid min and max bounds
Each left subtree must be < node.val

title: Design Twitter
description: Design a simplified Twitter with basic functionality.
hints: Use HashMap to store users and followers
Use HashMap for tweets by user
Use Min Heap for top 10 tweets

title: Add Two Numbers (Linked List)
description: You are given two non-empty linked lists. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list.
constraints: The number of nodes in each list is in the range [1, 100].

title: Generate Parentheses
description: Given n pairs of parentheses, generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.

title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Remove duplicates from sorted array in-place and return the number of unique elements.
hints: Use two pointers: slow and fast
When different value found, move slow and update

title: Rotate Array
description: Rotate the array to the right by k steps.
hints: Reverse first k elements, then n-k, then all

title: Jump Game
description: Determine if you can reach the last index of the array.
hints: If current position > furthest, can't reach

title: Group Anagrams
description: Group the anagrams together from an array of strings.
hints: Sort characters in each string as key
Group strings with same sorted key

title: Kth Largest Element in Array
description: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array.
hints: Use min heap of size k
Or use quickselect for O(n) average

title: House Robber
description: Maximum money that can be robbed from houses without robbing adjacent houses.

title: Regular Expression Matching
description: Regular expression matching with '.' and '*'.
hints: Use DP: dp[i][j] = match of s[0:i] with p[0:j]

title: Subsets (Power Set)
description: Generate all possible subsets (the power set) of an array.
hints: For each element, include it or exclude it

title: Implement Queue using Stacks
description: Implement a FIFO queue using only two stacks.
hints: Use two stacks: push_stack and pop_stack
On pop, transfer elements from push to pop

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given prices. Find the maximum profit you can achieve. You can buy and sell at most once.
hints: Track the minimum price so far

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Determine if an array contains any duplicate elements.
hints: Use a Set to track seen numbers
Return false at end if all unique

title: Valid Anagram
description: Determine if two strings are anagrams of each other.
hints: Or use frequency map for O(n)

title: Intersection of Two Arrays
description: Find all elements that appear in both arrays.
hints: Use Set to store elements from first array
Check if each element from second array exists in set

title: 3Sum
description: Find all unique triplets that sum to zero.
hints: For each element, use two pointers to find remaining sum
Skip duplicates to get unique triplets

title: Powx n
description: Compute x raised to the power n efficiently.

title: Sqrt x
description: Compute and return the square root of x (integer part).
hints: Find the largest integer whose square is <= x

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Search for a target value in a rotated sorted array.
hints: Check if target is in sorted half

title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
description: Find the starting and ending position of a given target value in a sorted array.
hints: Use binary search to find left boundary
Use binary search to find right boundary

title: Permutations
description: Generate all permutations of an array.
hints: Use a visited array to track used elements

title: Combinations
description: Given n and k, generate all appropriate combinations.

title: Unique Paths
description: Count the number of ways to reach the bottom-right corner from top-left.
hints: Can only move right or down

title: Minimum Path Sum
description: Find the minimum sum path from top-left to bottom-right.
hints: Can only move right or down

title: Minimum Cost to Make Array Equal
description: Find minimum operations to make all array elements equal.
hints: Cost is sum of abs differences from median

title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
description: Determine if array can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sum.
hints: Sum must be even to partition

title: Print all Subsequences
description: Print all possible subsequences of an array.

title: Sum of Subsets (Subset Sum)
description: Find all subsets with a given sum.
hints: Check if current sum equals target

title: N-Queens Problem
description: Place N queens on N×N chessboard such that no two queens attack each other.
hints: No two queens on same row, column, or diagonal

title: Sudoku Solver
description: Solve a Sudoku puzzle using backtracking.
constraints: Each row, column, 3x3 box has digits 1-9
hints: Check row, column, and 3x3 box constraints
Try digits 1-9 for each empty cell

title: Rat in a Maze
description: Find all paths for rat from top-left to bottom-right in a maze.
hints: Can move right and down (or all 4 directions)

title: Edit Distance
description: Find the minimum number of operations to convert one string to another.
hints: dp[i][j] = min operations for word1[0:i] to word2[0:j]

title: Wildcard Matching
description: Pattern matching with '?' and '*' wildcards.
hints: Use DP: dp[i][j] = match of s[0:i] with p[0:j]

title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Find the length of longest common subsequence between two strings.
hints: dp[i][j] = LCS length of text1[0:i] and text2[0:j]

title: Worst Case Time Complexity Sort
description: Understand and implement merge sort with guaranteed O(n log n) worst-case time.
hints: Merge sort guarantees O(n log n)
timeComplexity: O(n log n) worst, average, best

title: Number of 1 Bits
description: Count the number of '1' bits in the binary representation of an integer.
hints: Use bitwise AND with n-1 to remove rightmost 1 bit

title: Single Number III
description: Find two numbers that appear once while others appear twice.
hints: XOR all elements to get XOR of two unique numbers
Partition into two groups and XOR separately

title: Reverse Bits
description: Reverse bits of a 32-bit unsigned integer.

title: Majority Element
description: Find the element that appears more than n/2 times.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given elevation map, compute how much rainwater can be trapped.
hints: Track left max and right max
Water trapped at i = min(leftMax, rightMax) - height[i]

title: Gas Station
description: Find starting gas station to complete circular route visiting all stations.
hints: Total gas >= total cost is necessary
If balance < 0, start from next station

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Find the largest rectangular area in histogram.
hints: For each bar, find left and right boundaries

title: Palindrome Partitioning
description: Partition string into all possible palindrome combinations.
hints: Add to result when entire string is partitioned

title: Word Break
description: Determine if string can be segmented into dictionary words.
hints: dp[i] = true if s[0:i] can be segmented
Check all words ending at i

title: Word Search II
description: Find all words from dictionary in the board using backtracking.

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
description: Implement a Trie (prefix tree) with search, insert, startsWith.
hints: Mark end of word with boolean
timeComplexity: O(m) where m is length of word

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
description: Find the LCA of two nodes in a binary tree.
hints: Use DFS to find both nodes
LCA is root if p and q in different subtrees
If both in same subtree, recurse down

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a BST
description: Find the LCA of two nodes in a binary search tree.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Return level order traversal (BFS) of binary tree.
hints: Process one level at a time
Add children to queue for next level
spaceComplexity: O(w) where w is max width

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
description: Find the maximum path sum in a binary tree.
hints: Track max path for each subtree
Update global max at each node

title: Clone Graph
description: Create a deep copy of an undirected graph.
hints: Maintain HashMap of old to new nodes

title: Course Schedule II
description: Return order to take courses given prerequisites (topological sort).
hints: Or use DFS with visited states

title: Alien Dictionary
description: Find order of characters in alien dictionary from sorted words.
hints: Compare adjacent words to find order

title: Network Delay Time
description: Find minimum time for signal to reach all nodes from source.
hints: Return max distance or -1 if unreachable

title: Number of Connected Components in Graph
description: Count number of connected components in an undirected graph.
hints: Or DFS from each unvisited node

title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
description: Find minimum cost to connect all points using MST.

title: Implement Min Heap / Priority Queue
description: Implement a min heap with insert, delete-min, peek operations.

title: Find Median from Data Stream
description: Find median of stream of integers as they are added.
hints: Use max heap for smaller half
Use min heap for larger half
Balance so sizes differ by at most 1

title: Maximum Frequency Stack
description: Push, pop with most frequent element popped first.

testCases.input: push(5); push(7); push(5); pop(); pop(); pop()
push(1); push(2); push(3); pop(); pop(); pop()

hints: Pop from stack with max frequency
timeComplexity: O(1) for both push and pop

title: Design HashMap
description: Implement HashMap without using built-in libraries.

title: Design HashSet
description: Design a HashSet without using any built-in hash table libraries.

testCases.input: add(1); add(2); contains(1); contains(3); add(2); contains(2); remove(2); contains(2)
add(1); add(2); add(3); remove(2); contains(1); contains(2); contains(3)

hints: Think about how to store keys efficiently.
Use an array of buckets or another collision-handling technique.
A simple hash function can map keys to bucket indices.

title: Implement Queue using Stacks
description: Implement a queue using only two stacks. The queue should support push, pop, peek, and empty operations.

testCases.input: push(1); push(2); push(3); pop(); pop(); peek()

constraints: Operations are valid according to the queue interface
hints: Use two stacks to maintain the FIFO order.
One stack can be used for incoming elements and the other for outgoing elements.
Move elements between the stacks only when necessary.
